note: The public identity of the crawler (master plan O-2), decided by the operator on 2026-10-08 (CPD-0014). The values are public by nature (they are sent in every request and published in the crawler statement), so they are versioned here rather than kept in a workstation file. contact_url is the permanent public information page for website operators; its source is web/coprepan/crawler/index.html and it was verified reachable over HTTPS on deployment (docs/agent-runs/2026-10-08_crawler-site-storage-o2-o3-interim.md). The User-Agent is built by src/coprepan/crawler_identity.py: <crawler_name>/<package version> (+<contact_url>; <contact_email>).
